scope: Isolated bone-only sweeps on the fitted master: implementation integrity of commands, JCS measurement, centres, continuity and symmetry. Not an anatomical acceptance; contact mechanics, translations and follower couplings are not exercised.

subtalar_axis.source: Inman (as reported in search snippets); ANKLE_GEOMETRY review
subtalar_axis.use: Inversion/eversion command axis from posterior-plantar-lateral to anterior-dorsal-medial.

shoulder_girdle.directions: Elevation couples clavicular elevation, retraction and posterior axial rotation; scapular upward rotation, internal rotation and posterior tilt (SHOULDER_PINS, Ludewig 2009).
shoulder_girdle.unverified: Rate curves, upward rotation magnitude and plane dependence are not sourced here.

knee_screw_home.direction: Tibial external rotation in terminal extension (KNEE_SHM).
knee_screw_home.source: Fluoroscopic dynamic knee study: tibia externally rotated 3.6 deg relative to the femur as the knee extended (search snippet); stair ascent 4 deg over 57 deg (second snippet)
knee_screw_home.shape: Applied linearly over the last 20 deg of extension (shape not sourced; terminal-extension locking described over the last ~10 deg).

sources: Bone-pin study, active scapular-plane elevation (McClure et al. 2001; search snippet): 50 (SD 4.8) upward, 30 (13.0) posterior tilt, 24 (12.8) external rotation
GH-relative rate 0.43 deg scapular upward rotation per deg GH elevation (search snippet)
scapulothoracic_rhythm.cross_check: 0.43 x 117.5 = 50.5 deg upward rotation; 117.5 + 50.5 = 168 deg, matching the CDC humerothoracic flexion mean (168.8).
scapulothoracic_rhythm.clavicle_retraction_source: Secondary review snippet: clavicle retracts about 15 deg at the SC joint during elevation; elevation typically below 10 deg (bound only, not applied); posterior rotation about 30 deg (consistent with SHOULDER_PINS 31 deg)
scapulothoracic_rhythm.unverified: Tilt/external-rotation/clavicle curves scaled linearly with GH elevation; clavicular elevation not applied (only an upper bound is sourced); plane dependence not applied.

wrist_stage_split.evidence_conflict: Accessible snippets disagree (radiocarpal and midcarpal contribute almost equally to flexion versus midcarpal 65-72 percent of flexion; radiocarpal predominates flexion and midcarpal extension).
wrist_stage_split.unverified: Gross wrist commands are split equally between radiocarpal and midcarpal and labelled unverified.
